data.description: 【丛雨 · 穗织温泉街的薄荷洋装漫步】温泉水汽袅袅的穗织古街石板路上，两旁是古色古香的和风旅馆与垂柳。丛雨换上一袭清凉的薄荷白吊带洋装，头戴系着红丝带的草帽。她轻快地单手压着草帽帽檐，另一只手在身边欢快摆动，好奇地打量着街边各式各样的小吃摊位，草绿色的长发在夏日微风中轻扬。
data.lighting: 明朗纯净的夏日山间阳光穿透柳树枝条的斑驳绿影
data.location: 穗织镇温泉老街石板路
data.promptProse: Murasame walks lightly along the Hoori hot-spring street in her white-and-mint sundress and brown sandals, keeping one hand on her red-ribboned straw hat while the other swings freely. The slightly low cowboy view follows stone paving between old inns and willow branches, with food stalls beside her. Clear mountain sunlight breaks through the willow leaves onto her green hair and dress, while steam softens the farther wooden facades.
data.title: 丛雨 · 穗织温泉街的薄荷洋装漫步
